weapons.name: Doom Cloud
weapons.status: Default primary for the Assassin ("Price: Default", Level 1) [Fan-wiki infobox]. It has been in the game since Botch launched in BBG 2.1. The wiki dates 2.1 to July 15, 2013 [Fan-wiki: Updates], and SkyVu's own Google Play text reads "New in 2.1: - New Character Class! ASSASSIN: Botch" [Canon, archived Google Play 2013-08-15, quoted in /home/user/thallo-site/research_notes/Battle Bears character lore/huggable_botch_b1000.md; not re-fetched today because Wayback was unreachable]. No removal or rework is recorded. In BB Heroes (2024) Doom Cloud comes back as Botch's Super (see mechanics) [Canon]. Whether the 2026 build keeps it is [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: [Game text via wiki] "This cute little thing is hiding a deadly secret. Once it's out a myriad of lasers create a cloud of doom around itself, but it sure is adorable, huh?" — https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Doom_Cloud . BBH-era [Canon]: "Botch's "Doom Star" acts as a boomerang, potentially dealing double damage, while his "Doom Cloud" Super unleashes a bullet-raining cloud for widespread damage." — https://battlebears.com/pages/characters (text found in the saved copy /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/tillman_arsenal/web/characters.html)
weapons.mechanics: Fire mode: a summoned, deployable rain-of-bullets cloud with a fixed duration. Stats: 45 DPS, Duration 4 s, Ammo 1, Reload 5.5 s, no stat modifier; Damage+1/+2 add 2.5/5 [Fan-wiki infobox]. Idle: "follows the player around as a floating mass of green substance" [Fan-wiki]. Activation: "the Assassin launches a green starfish-like cloud into the air. It spins around and releases a rain of neon green bullets"; "it rotates then raises itself into the air under the Assassin's direction and releases a rapid barrage of raining green bullets" [Fan-wiki]. The cloud's height sets how wide the bullets spread. Bullets "disappear on contact with solid surfaces", but the wiki says the cloud still damages players under roofs [Fan-wiki]. End: "the cloud lowers itself to the ground and peters out in a burst of green light" [Fan-wiki]. It "immediately self-destructs" when Botch dies, and contact with a solid surface or platform destroys it at once [Fan-wiki]. Botch cannot melee or switch weapons while it is active [Fan-wiki]. Glitch: the cloud keeps shooting into the reload animation, so it "look[s] that Botch has two Doom Clouds" [Fan-wiki]. Impact result: the wiki describes damage only; there is no status effect and no explosion. It shows the idle Doom Cloud as a translucent lime-green starfish- or octopus-like blob with about five drooping points, floating low in front of Botch, with HUD ammo 1/1 and a green starfish-shaped weapon icon topped by a white dome [Observed]. /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/png2/Doom-cloud-navi-icon.png is a 70x54 lime-green starfish-splat icon [Observed]. /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/crops/cb_hq3.png (YouTube hq3 thumbnail of the same clip) shows long lime-green spike- or needle-shaped streaks slanting down to the floor and enemy body parts flying, with the Doom Cloud icon and ammo 0/1 [Observed]. That these streaks are the Doom Cloud's falling bullets is [Inference]. Depiction for shorts: a lime-green translucent starfish blob bobbing beside him; it spins and rises, then rains green needles in a widening circle, then sinks and pops into a green flash. Every step is documented above except the exact spin and rise timing [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Chaos Toss
weapons.status: Unlock for 100,000 Joules, Level 1 [Fan-wiki infobox]. It appears in a wiki screenshot of the v2.1 matchmaking screen (File:Chaos Toss.jpg, uploaded 2013-07-21, with a "2.1" version label) [Observed], so it was most likely available from launch in 2.1 [Inference]. Reworked in 2.6 (Dec 20, 2013): damage 7 to 15, range 50 to 100, Speed Modifier 0 to 5%, Ammo+2 1 to 0 [Fan-wiki: Battle Bears Gold/Versions/2.6, which probably copies SkyVu's 2.6 change log; Wayback could not be reached to check].
weapons.official_text: [Game text via wiki] "One would say creating a hand that throws poison clouds is a waste of a really cool superpower, but those people are no longer with us." — https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Chaos_Toss
weapons.mechanics: Fire mode: lobbed projectile on a slight arc, two shots per clip. Stats: 12 damage per second over 6 seconds, Rate of Fire 1 s, Ammo 2, Reload 4 s, +5% speed, projectile speed 1,250 u/s; it cannot take Damage+ [Fan-wiki infobox and text]. Look of the shot: "a skeletal hand that shoots a gleaming blob with a slight arc"; "lobs a gleaming orb that explodes into a toxic green cloud when it comes into contact with any player or surface" [Fan-wiki]. Impact result: no direct-hit damage. The hit leaves a poison cloud "similar to that of the Mother of Nature, but the cloud is green instead of purple", with about half that weapon's duration and a smaller area [Fan-wiki]. Mother of Nature's cloud is a "large purple plume" [Fan-wiki]. Status effect: Poisoned, damage over time; poison stacks; Botch can poison himself [Fan-wiki]. Poisoned players show "a purple/green skull" over their head [Fan-wiki: Status Effects]. OBSERVED: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/png/ChaosTossCR.png and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/png2/Chaos_Toss.png show a large, translucent, glowing lime-green skeletal hand with segmented, crystal-like finger bones curled in an open claw. It floats free beside Botch's raised paw and is about the size of his head [Observed]. I did not see the thrown blob or the cloud in any image [Unverified]. Depiction for shorts: the bony green hand flicks a glowing green blob in an arc; it bursts into a low green gas cloud, and a green skull pops over the victim's head. The cloud colour is documented; its shape and scale are [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Toxic Plague
weapons.status: Unlock for 50 Gas, Level 10 [Fan-wiki infobox]. Added in BBG 2.17 on March 8, 2015 ("Toxic Plague for Assassin!") [Fan-wiki: Updates]. A fan video titled "Battle Bears Gold Update 2.17 - NEW WEAPON: TOXIC PLAGUE" confirms the timing [fan YouTube XqQ-edWQ-7Y description via wiki file metadata]. No rework is recorded on the wiki, which links an official 2.17 forum "Balance Update" thread that could not be reached today.
weapons.official_text: [Game text via wiki] "Pop one of these babies out onto the field and watch the neon gas show! " — https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Toxic_Plague
weapons.mechanics: Fire mode: a thrown, bouncing ball that leaves a gas trail; one throw per clip. Stats: 18 damage per second for 3 seconds, Rate of Fire 4 s, Ammo 1, Reload 4.5 s, projectile speed 600 u/s; Damage+1/+2 add 2/4 [Fan-wiki]. Behaviour: "the assassin will throw the ball to the direction the player is aiming at. The ball is very sensible to contact, and will drastically change it's direction whenever it makes contact with a surface, projectile or player. As it moves, the ball leaves a green gas trail behind it" [Fan-wiki]. Status effect: Poisoned. Poison "will stack on them if they follow the trail or move too much throughout the gas" [Fan-wiki]. weapons.name: Cosmic Fire
weapons.status: Unlock for 60 Gas, Level 1 [Fan-wiki infobox]. Added in BBG 2.3 on September 27, 2013 [Fan-wiki: Updates]. A fan video's copy of the "2.3 (Beta) Release Notes" lists "Botch: Cosmic Fire, Cosmic Bomb" [fan YouTube XlZo37G6hs4 description]. Reworked in 2.6 (Dec 20, 2013): "Duration increased from 5 to 10", "Reload speed increased from 3 to 5" [Fan-wiki: Versions/2.6]. That conflicts with the weapon page, which says it ceases after 5 s and reloads in 5 s [Fan-wiki]; I could not check which is current.
weapons.official_text: [Game text via wiki] "Sometimes "killing it with fire" is the only way to deal with something, amirite?" — https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Cosmic_Fire
weapons.mechanics: Fire mode: a medium-range flamethrower stream that lasts a set time. Stats: 65.0 DPS (the wiki says testing gives "inconsistent results"), Ammo 1, Reload 5 s; Damage+1/+2 add 7.5/15 [Fan-wiki]. Weapon Statistics lists Cosmic Fire among weapons with a positive Health Modifier [Fan-wiki]. Specials cannot be used while firing [Fan-wiki]. Look: "the Assassin points his palm forwards and the fire he holds in his hand begins to burn much more vigorously, damaging any enemy in its path"; the flame passes through enemies and hits groups [Fan-wiki]. Impact result: continuous damage only; no status effect is documented. OBSERVED: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/png/CosmicFire.png (File:CosmicFire.jpg) shows the idle state: a flame in Botch's upturned palm with a white-hot core, lime-green outer flames and small cyan or teal sparks rising [Observed]. /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/png/CosmicFireconceptart.png (File:CosmicFireconceptart.png, watermarked "SkyVu Entertainment", uploaded by a fan in 2015) shows Botch, drawn charcoal with a frowning face and a brown backpack, pushing a long, wavy, billowing lime-green flame stream forward from both paws, with green particles under his feet [Observed; SkyVu origin inferred from the watermark]. The same palm flame appears in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/png/DefaultBotch2.png, the wiki's image of his default skin [Observed]. That screenshot therefore has Cosmic Fire equipped; the flame is not part of his base look [Inference].

weapons.name: Orbs
weapons.status: Unlock for 60 Gas, no level lock [Fan-wiki]. Added in BBG 2.7 on January 23, 2014 [Fan-wiki: Updates]. No later change is recorded.
weapons.official_text: [Game text via wiki] "Sometimes when a person gets lonely they talk to themselves. Botch, however, created two friends that rapidly fire deadly lasers... friends are the best!" — https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Orbs
weapons.mechanics: Fire mode: a rapid-fire laser stream that runs until the clip is empty. Stats: 3 damage per shot, Rate of Fire 0.05 s, Ammo 60, Reload 5 s in the infobox but "a lengthy 6 second reload" in the text, an internal conflict [Fan-wiki]; Damage+1/+2 add 0.3/0.6, Ammo+1/+2 add 9/18 [Fan-wiki]. Look: "Botch holds one floating orb each in his hands. Botch fires a laser that will continue to fire until the ammo count is fully depleted" [Fan-wiki]. Impact result: hit damage only; no status effect. OBSERVED: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/png/Orba.png (File:Orba.jpg) shows two glowing lime-green orbs, one hovering beside each raised paw at head height. Each has a swirled inner core and a bright white-yellow faceted halo [Observed]. I did not see the laser's colour or thickness in any image [Unverified]. Do not confuse these with the Fear Orbit (a secondary whose two lattice orbs circle him and poison on contact) [Inference].

weapons.name: Energy Bombs
weapons.status: Unlock for 60 Gas, no level lock [Fan-wiki]. Added in BBG 2.7; the page says "Date released: January 23rd 2014" [Fan-wiki]. A bug in 2.17 made one bomb deal the damage of four; the wiki says it is patched, and Updates lists "Energy Bombs Fixed" in 2.19 (April 26, 2015) [Fan-wiki]. The wiki marks the page as a stub.
weapons.official_text: [Game text via wiki] "Why make one bomb, when you can have 4! Fires an explosion in all 4 directions from Botch." — https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Energy_Bombs
weapons.mechanics: Fire mode: one trigger launches four bombs outward in four directions. Explosive splash: Explosives 25-35, Area of Effect "Max Dmg 125.0, Min Dmg 225.0", Rate of Fire 1.0 s, Ammo 4, Reload 5 s; Explosions+1/+2 add 5/10 [Fan-wiki]. Behaviour: "Botch fires bombs towards all four directions that explodes on contact with either the enemy or any solid object" [Fan-wiki]. Status effect: none documented. OBSERVED: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/png/Energy_bombs.png (File:Energy bombs.jpg) shows one glowing lime-green ball covered in short pyramidal spikes, like a sea mine, floating above Botch's shoulder [Observed]. I saw no image of the explosion [Unverified]. Depiction for shorts: four spiky green mines fly out in a plus-sign pattern. The colour of the blast is [BBG News invention] (lime green would match his other explosives).

weapons.name: Hazard Toy
weapons.status: Unlock for 60 Gas, Level 1 [Fan-wiki infobox]. Added in BBG 2.27 on May 29, 2017, alongside Fidget Boomer and Spin Baby Spin [Fan-wiki: Updates]. It is missing from the Assassin (BBG) class page and sits in the _unassigned bucket of weapons_by_class.json, but the wiki files it under Category:Assassin and its infobox says Class: Assassin [Fan-wiki].
weapons.official_text: [Game text via wiki] "Banned from elementary schools world wide, this weapon is as dangerous as it looks!" — https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Hazard_Toy
weapons.mechanics: Fire mode: a straight-flying projectile that explodes and poisons. Stats: Explosives 25-50, Damage 4 (poison), Duration 5 s, Area of Effect "Max Dmg 75.0, Min Dmg 150.0", Rate of Fire 1.5 s, Ammo 3, Reload 3.5 s, projectile speed 1,100 u/s; Explosions+1/+2 add 2.5/5 [Fan-wiki]. Behaviour: "a projectile weapon which explodes upon contact and poisons enemies caught in the radius"; it flies straight, unlike the Chaos Toss's arc; the poison is weak (about Fear Orbit's level) but stacks across clouds [Fan-wiki]. Status effect: Poisoned, which puts a purple/green skull overhead [Fan-wiki: Status Effects]. The wiki says it is "based off of the Fidget Spinner" [Fan-wiki]. OBSERVED: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/png/HazardToy.png (File:HazardToy.jpeg, 2017) shows a translucent green fidget spinner beside Botch: three broad, rounded fan blades around a central disc patterned with dark and light green concentric rings [Observed]. The three-blade layout resembles the radiation-hazard trefoil [Inference]. I saw no explosion or cloud [Unverified].

weapons.name: Pain Field
weapons.status: Default secondary for the Assassin, Level 1, since BBG 2.1 (July 2013) [Fan-wiki]. The wiki calls it the first "Field" weapon; later fields went to the Arbiter [Fan-wiki]. No rework is recorded.
weapons.official_text: [Game text via wiki] "This field speeds projectiles to cause pain faster. Anyone inside takes 50% more hurting from dangerous things flying around. And we mean anyone, increases damage on enemies and teammates alike." — https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Pain_Field
weapons.mechanics: Fire mode: a deployable area-of-effect field that does no damage itself. Stats: Ammo 1, Duration 15 s, Reload 3 s, Cooldown 1 s, no stat modifier [Fan-wiki]. Effect: "Any damage dealt is increased by 50% within the field" for enemies and allies alike; it has a large area and does not slow anyone [Fan-wiki]. The status is "Damage Susceptible", with "No overhead icon shown" [Fan-wiki: Status Effects]. Look: "a small compact pink orb that floats by Botch's side. When activated though, it grows massively and transforms into a large barrier of compact hexagons. It is somewhat different in colour to the Assassin's other weapons, which are all a dark lime green" [Fan-wiki]. OBSERVED: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/png/PainFieldCR.png (File:PainFieldCR.jpg) shows a small pink-red orb with a honeycomb texture floating beside Botch [Observed]. /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/png/Imagef.png (File:Imagef.jpg, captioned "The Pain Field in effect", 2013) shows the deployed field: a huge translucent magenta-violet sphere made of faceted hexagonal plates against the sky, a smaller pink faceted orb, and a pink hex-ball weapon icon at ammo 1/1 [Observed]. This is the one magenta weapon in his otherwise lime-green kit [Observed].

weapons.name: Fear Orbit
weapons.status: Unlock for 60 Gas, no level lock [Fan-wiki]. Available from the class launch in 2.1 [Fan-wiki trivia]. Changed in development: "In the beta version of v2.1, the Fear Orbit dealt no poison damage and instead injured the enemy with direct hits from the orbs. This was changed just prior to release" [Fan-wiki]. Reworked in 2.6 (Dec 20, 2013): damage 5 to 10, duration 10 to 5, reload 7 to 5 [Fan-wiki: Versions/2.6].
weapons.official_text: [Game text via wiki] "Most people think having orbs of poison spinning around you is a bad idea. Botch is not most people. One touch from these puppies and you'll be quite sickly, most likely to the point of death." — https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Fear_Orbit
weapons.mechanics: Fire mode: a self-centred orbiting hazard that lasts a set time and works alongside the primary. Stats: 24 DPS over duration, Duration 5 s, Ammo 1, Reload 5 s; Damage+1/+2 add 6/12 [Fan-wiki]. Look and behaviour: "two rotating, poisonous orbs that circle the Assassin"; when activated it "begins to orbit the Assassin violently, differentiating from its more passive non-active state"; very short range [Fan-wiki]. Status effect: Poisoned on contact, with a skull icon overhead [Fan-wiki]. OBSERVED: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/png/FearOrbitCR.png (File:FearOrbitCR.jpg) shows two lime-green geodesic spheres with a hexagon lattice like a soccer ball, one high and one low beside Botch, trailing glowing yellow-green dots [Observed].

weapons.name: Cosmic Bomb
weapons.status: Unlock for 120,000 Joules, Level 1 [Fan-wiki]. Added in BBG 2.3 on September 27, 2013 [Fan-wiki: Updates; also listed in a fan video's copy of the 2.3 beta notes]. Reworked in 2.6 (Dec 20, 2013): "Minimum damage increased from 300 to 400" [Fan-wiki: Versions/2.6]. The current infobox says Min Dmg 450.0, so it may have changed again [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: [Game text via wiki] "It may be a bit clumsy and nonchalant, but sometimes Botch can't be bothered by all the excess energy he has stored in his body. So he'll throw it to the sky and it'll come down later in a giant explosion." — https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Cosmic_Bomb
weapons.mechanics: Fire mode: a charged vertical lob that falls back as a delayed bomb. Explosive splash: Explosives 20-40, Area of Effect "Max Dmg 150.0, Min Dmg 450.0", Ammo 3, Reload 6.0 s; Explosions+1/+2 add 5/10 [Fan-wiki]. Sequence: "the Assassin accumulates energy for the orb in his hands for three seconds and then lobs a very large orb of energy upwards into the air. This orb charges further while in the sky, and descends again straight downwards after several seconds". On the way up it passes through roofs and structures; on the way down it hits the first thing it touches, "creating a green, spherical explosion" that can hurt Botch too; the full up-and-down trip takes 10 s [Fan-wiki]. Trivia: projectiles can detonate it; it can stall against a map's skybox; it does not home [Fan-wiki]. Status effect: none. OBSERVED: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/png/CosmicBomb.png shows the charge: Botch holds a white-core, lime-green glowing ball at his chest in both paws, which lights his body green [Observed]. /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/png/Bolt.png (captioned "Cosmic Bomb descending") shows the fall as a vertical comet of stacked glowing blobs, yellow-green at the bottom, white in the middle and a pale cyan tail on top [Observed]. /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/png/Explosion.png (captioned "Cosmic Bomb upon impact") shows a large translucent green bubble on the ground with a white flash core and a chain of green ellipses rising above it, on a night temple map [Observed]. /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/png/Blow_up_cosmic_fire.png (captioned "A player being blown up by a Cosmic Bomb") shows a huge pale green-yellow translucent sphere while an enemy ragdolls upward. Its HUD, however, shows the Doom Cloud selected at 0/1 alongside green streaks, so which weapon caused the blast is uncertain [Observed + Inference]. /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/png/CosmicBombConceptArt.png (SkyVu-watermarked concept art) shows Botch throwing upward one-handed, two alternative orb designs marked "either or" (a green glowing ball with a halo ring, and a swirling green orb), a ground blast as a flat burst with radiating rays, and a "Top view" of swirling green rings [Observed]. Depiction for shorts: charge, toss skyward, beat, a comet streak down, then a green bubble blast. All of this is documented; comic delay lengths are [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Nova
weapons.status: Unlock for 60 Gas, no level lock [Fan-wiki]. Added in BBG 2.7 on January 23, 2014 [Fan-wiki: Updates]. No later change is recorded.
weapons.official_text: [Game text via wiki] "Power of the nova force! Creates a column of damage for a short time on the map." — https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Nova
weapons.mechanics: Fire mode: a ground-eruption area attack that hits twice. Explosive splash: Explosives "15-30.0 (x2)", Area of Effect "Max Dmg 150.0, Min Dmg 300.0", Ammo 1, Reload 3 s; Explosions+1/+2 add 5/10 [Fan-wiki]. Look: "the Nova will cause a huge column of green energy to spring from the ground, dealing damage to any enemy within the blast radius twice"; moderate area, close range; "The column will stop at at Botch's feet, meaning that if a player is under the Nova, the player will not be damaged" [Fan-wiki]. notes:
TOTAL: Botch has 15 BBG weapons: 7 primaries (Doom Cloud, Chaos Toss, Toxic Plague, Cosmic Fire, Orbs, Energy Bombs, Hazard Toy), 5 secondaries (Pain Field, Fear Orbit, Cosmic Bomb, Nova, Gravity Well) and 3 melees (Crass Knuckles, Ball N Pain, Tonguechuks). The 16th entry, Doom Star, is a BB Heroes attack only. weapons_by_class.json["Botch"] has 14; Hazard Toy is in "_unassigned" but belongs to the Assassin (its infobox says Class: Assassin and it is in Category:Assassin). The class page omits it and "Assassin (BBG)/Weapons" is a one-line stub [Fan-wiki]. Category:Assassin has no other weapons. Botch has no unique specials; the 10 Specials are shared by all classes [Fan-wiki].

ERA:
- BBR (2011-2013): Botch did not exist and had no weapons. The only BBR-era trace is a Marecraft map Easter egg (BBR 1.4.3), \"two mysterious outlines of the same bear with a chewed-off ear\" [Fan-wiki].
- BBG timeline [Fan-wiki: Updates]: 2.1 (July 15, 2013; SkyVu store text \"New in 2.1: - New Character Class! ASSASSIN: Botch\" [Canon via prior notes]) brought Doom Cloud, Pain Field, Crass Knuckles, Chaos Toss, Fear Orbit and Ball N Pain. 2.3 (Sep 27, 2013) added Cosmic Fire and Cosmic Bomb. 2.4 (Oct 24, 2013): \"Assassin's health was slightly reduced and speed slightly increased\". The template still says 90 health, but 2015-2016 screenshots show 85/85 [Observed]. 2.6 (Dec 20, 2013) brought balance changes to Cosmic Fire, Cosmic Bomb, Chaos Toss, Fear Orbit, Crass Knuckles and Ball N Pain. 2.7 (Jan 23, 2014) added Orbs, Energy Bombs, Gravity Well and Nova. 2.17 (Mar 8, 2015) added Toxic Plague. 2.19 (Apr 26, 2015): Energy Bombs fixed. 2.21 (Jul 3, 2015) added Tonguechuks. 2.27 (May 29, 2017) added Hazard Toy. 3.0 (Nov 15, 2021): \"All +1 Equipment has been removed except Speed +1\" and \"Equipment Slot 2 has been removed\", so every Damage+/Explosions+/Ammo+/Melee+ table predates 2021.
- No Botch weapon is recorded as removed.
- BBH (2024): the kit shrinks to Doom Star (boomerang) plus Doom Cloud as the Super [Canon].
- 2026 re-release: Steam lists \"ASSASSIN: Botch\" and \"80+ PRIMARY WEAPONS / 60+ SECONDARY WEAPONS / 50+ MELEES\" [Canon]. Botch does not appear in any of the five Steam screenshots, the 54 s trailer (I checked all 108 frames on contact sheets at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/botch/trailer_sheets/) or the Steam extras clip (a gold Wil) [Observed]. None of the seven 2026 Steam news posts mention him. JustNubz's showcase covers the Assassin from 39:57 to 44:12 in the \"closed playtest of BBG (the 4th one)\" (from its description). Its hq thumbnails show no Botch, and the chapter thumbnail hqdefault_2410100.jpg returned 404. I did not watch it, so whether his 2026 kit matches 2013-2017 is [Unverified].

CLASS-WIDE VISUAL RULES:
- Almost every weapon is a floating, translucent, glowing lime-green energy construct that hovers beside his paw (skeletal hand, spiked fist, spiked ball, orbs, disc, flame, starfish cloud) [Observed].
- Exceptions: Pain Field is pink/magenta with hexagons [Observed; Fan-wiki agrees], and Tonguechuks is a physical black/red/silver/green object [Observed].
- Fur reads dark brown-taupe in the July 2013 uploads (DoomCloudCR, ChaosTossCR, CrassKnucklesCR, PainFieldCR) and dark plum/aubergine in later ones (CosmicFire, Orba, BallNPain, Gravity well, HazardToy) [Observed]. The cause (2.4 \"Graphic enhancements\", device or capture) is [Unverified].
- In-game arm guards are grey with red lights. SkyVu-style promo renders (File:Botch.jpg, File:Frontpage-news-botch-release.png) show blue-lit bands and collar [Observed]. These lights probably follow team colour; the wiki notes team-coloured red/blue on the Jester skin [Inference].
- Poisoned targets show a purple/green skull overhead; Pain Field shows no icon [Fan-wiki].
- Killed enemies burst into flying body parts (fan screenshots and 2026 Steam screens) [Observed].

ERRORS IN /home/user/thallo-site/bbg-news-repo/characters/botch.md:
(1) Look and Prompt pack treat \"a small green flame in one paw\" / \"green flame in one hand [Observed: screenshot]\" as his default look. That flame is the Cosmic Fire primary (60 Gas, added v2.3). DefaultBotch2.jpg (uploaded Oct 27, 2013) simply has it equipped. His default loadout is Doom Cloud + Pain Field + Crass Knuckles.
(2) The video prompt \"two glowing orbs circling him\" and the Fear Orbit idle mix up two weapons. Orbs is a primary: one glowing orb held by each paw, firing lasers. Fear Orbit is a secondary: two geodesic lattice spheres that circle him and poison on contact. Neither is a default.
(3) The Weapons bullet leaves out Chaos Toss, Cosmic Fire, Energy Bombs, Hazard Toy, Nova, Ball N Pain and Tonguechuks.
(4) The single toxic-effects green #6CF542 does not fit Pain Field (magenta) or Tonguechuks.
(5) The \"blue-lit band\" belongs to the BBH icon and promo art; in-game BBG bands are grey with red lights, probably team colour.
The Doom Cloud / Doom Star [Canon] lines are correct.

CONFLICTS:
- Cosmic Fire: the page says 5 s attack and 5 s reload; the 2.6 log says duration 5 to 10 and reload 3 to 5.
- Orbs reload: infobox 5 s vs text 6 s.
- Cosmic Bomb min damage: 2.6 says 300 to 400, infobox says 450.
- Crass Knuckles and Ball N Pain equipment bonuses are older than the 2.6 numbers.
- Gravity Well is called \"orb-like\" in the text but appears as a disc in the image and a \"frisbee\" in the item text.
- The \"Cosmic Bomb\" captions on Blow_up_cosmic_fire.jpg and fan video c8HwXqm9_Rc show a Doom Cloud loadout.

CONCEPT ART: CosmicFireconceptart.png and CosmicBombConceptArt.png carry a \"SkyVu Entertainment\" watermark but were uploaded by a fan in 2015. I treat them as probable official concept art with unverified provenance.
